@smartledger/bsv.9.34.0: Cannot parse three output scripts the reference node accepts and mines (an OP_RETURN followed by a push whose length field is cut off), so a transaction carrying one has no script verdict here. This is a false reject: no script is accepted that the node refuses. Fixed in 9.35.0.
@smartledger/bsv.9.35.0: GDAF generateAgeProof ignores the credential it is given and commits to a hardcoded birth date of 1995-06-15, so a proof that a subject meets an age threshold can be obtained for a subject who does not - measured on this version, a credential for a subject born 2015-03-01 verified true at every minimum age from 1 to 31. It was a constant function of its first argument: ten input shapes, including undefined and null, returned one commitment between them. A relying party that treats a true from verifyAgeProof as evidence about the credential subject is affected; verification needs the opening, which carries the birth date in plaintext. Fixed in 9.36.0, which takes the birth date itself and refuses a credential. Upgrade to @smartledger/bsv@9.36.0 or later. https://github.com/codenlighten/smartledger-bsv/security/advisories/GHSA-2j2f-5v2f-pvpq
